description.translate:
Here is what the key opens.

A Map Device. The Guard used them to step into ground we had surveyed but could not march to. There are four left and I am not sentimental about the other three.

You are not being rewarded. You are being *dispatched*. Bring back what the ruins are holding.

Commissioned, then. The roster has two names on it again.

Go carefully. Everything out there was killed once already and did not take it well.
